senses.gloss: אַקְלֵיד (denom. of אַקֶלִידָא) to lock up, insert the key
to be inserted like a key; to be swallowed up, disappear.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 93b:10">Ḥull. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>אִיקְּלוּדֵי מִיקְּלִיד</he> (or <he>אַקְלוּדֵי</he>; Ms. R. <he>אַקְלִידֵי</he>; Ms. R. 2 <he>קַלּוּדֵי מִקְּלַד</he>, or <he>מְקַלַּד</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) the sinew disappears in the flesh.
